$note: Runtime gateway settings that are neither secrets nor plan-specific.
$hosts_note: TWO HOSTS, TWO OWNERS. commercial_host is the marketing/docs site and is served by VERCEL (ufc.proptechusa.ai is a CNAME to vercel-dns); it does NOT serve /v1. api_base_url is the Cloudflare Worker that actually serves /v1, /health, /admin and /dashboard/api, and it is PRODUCTION infrastructure despite the historical `preview` label on its wrangler environment. Never attach ufc.proptechusa.ai to the Worker: that rewrites the Vercel DNS record and takes the site down.
$api_base_url_note: The base URL customers call, the origin the portal's browser client calls, and OpenAPI servers[0]. Today the portal is static on Vercel, so this is always cross-origin (the gateway sends CORS headers). If ufc.proptechusa.ai ever serves /v1 itself, change this value — do not hard-code a host anywhere else.

cors_public_api.expose: X-Request-Id, X-Upstream-Request-Id, X-API-Version, X-Gateway-Version, X-Plan, X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset, X-Quota-Limit, X-Quota-Remaining, X-Quota-Reset
